channel.title: Ghassan Alhamoud — AI Architecture & Automation
channel.description: AI architecture, systems engineering, distributed systems, and the hard problems nobody’s solving — by Ghassan Alhamoud.

item.title: I Stopped Guessing What to Automate. So I Built an Open-Source Miner.
item.description: Most AI projects start with a solution and search for a problem. Automation Miner turns domain evidence into a citable, scored portfolio of opportunities worth investigating.

item.title: Your Agent Does Not Need Inbox Access. It Needs Email Intelligence.
item.description: Raw mailbox access gave my agents messages, not understanding — and exposed them to untrusted content. So I built an open-source, local-first email intelligence layer.

item.title: The Ghost in the Terminal: Testing TUIs with tmux
item.description: Testing terminal UIs is not a stdin/stdout problem. It is a PTY problem. Here is the tmux-driven pattern that made a real Textual app deterministic to drive, inspect, and verify.

item.title: From Agent Experience to Portable Knowledge: Integrating ALMS and OKF
item.description: A governed promotion path from ALMS operational learnings to portable OKF bundles: thresholds, provenance, conflicts, security, and version compatibility.

item.title: When Smart Models Go Stupid: 5,000 Lines of Perfect Analysis, Then a print() Statement
item.description: I asked GPT-5.5/Codex to build a TUI for my film pipeline. It produced a brilliant 5,000-line design analysis and then delivered a input()/print() REPL. This is the story of the training data blind spot and why you can't trust analysis quality as a signal for delivery quality.

item.title: SkillLedger: A Verification and Entitlement Layer for Agent Skills
item.description: Inside SkillLedger's MVP trust model: versioned manifests, deterministic integrity checks, separate approval, entitlements, ledger entries, and explicit limits.

item.title: ALMS: Shared Operational Memory for Autonomous Agents via MCP
item.description: Inside ALMS 0.1.0: a Go/PostgreSQL MCP control plane for shared operational learnings, gap-safe sync, protocols, OKF export, and explicit limits.

item.title: Quality vs Speed with AI Agents: A Risk-Based Gate Framework
item.description: A practical framework for routing AI-agent work through fast, standard, or critical quality gates based on impact, reversibility, sensitivity, authority, and verifiability.

item.title: Building an AI Film Pipeline: Architecture, Failures, and Current Evidence
item.description: An evidence-backed postmortem covering historical production failures, eight-phase architecture, current scope, and a 1,840-test verification snapshot.

item.title: Auditing a 12-Hour AI Go Code-Generation Marathon
item.description: A repository-backed audit of a 12-hour AI-assisted Go marathon: 32 measured feature commits, tool growth, a 97-parameter constructor, and a reusable release gate.

item.title: Agent-First Entity Database: Schema, MCP Contract, and Benchmarks
item.description: Inside EntityScope: a zero-UI DuckDB knowledge base for agents, with field-level provenance, bounded MCP tools, measured query latency, test results, and reusable contracts.

item.title: Structured Agent Handoffs: Contracts, State Machines, and Acceptance Gates
item.description: A production pattern for delegating coding work between agents: typed scope, permissions, idempotency, lifecycle states, retries, acceptance evidence, and hard-won integration failures.

item.title: Your Agent Spends 30 Seconds Finding Files - Here's How I Cut It to 3ms
item.description: Every time your agent needs to find a file, it scans the entire directory tree. Here's the architecture for a solution that reads the entire workspace in 3ms.

item.title: Self-Healing Agent Systems: A Bounded Remediation State Machine
item.description: A production design for self-healing agent runtimes: typed detection, confidence, preconditions, idempotency, bounded remediation, verification, compensation, circuit breakers, and escalation.

item.title: Issue Management as a Reliability Control Plane
item.description: A durable issue-control-plane design for agent systems: fingerprints, lifecycle states, evidence-backed root cause, corrective-action classes, verification windows, recurrence, and machine-readable records.

item.title: Five Failures From Three Months Building a Personal AI Agent
item.description: A documented failure timeline from three months operating a personal AI agent: provider loss, daemon outages, unsafe self-modification, reboot fragility, and unverified fixes.

item.title: Five Infrastructure Layers Every Production AI Agent Needs
item.description: A production AI agent reference architecture covering transport, policy, orchestration, verification and recovery, and observability—with interfaces, failure modes, and readiness gates.

item.title: What a 250-Item Agent Run Actually Proved
item.description: An evidence-backed postmortem of a 252-item workflow, plus a reproducible 250-case protocol that tests recovery without confusing throughput with self-healing.

item.title: The Same Automation Pattern Across Six Industries: A Comparative Study
item.description: A six-domain comparison of top-scoring automation candidates: triggers, bottlenecks, available data, risks, expected value, confidence, and selection bias.

item.title: How an AI System Found and Scored 42 Automation Opportunities
item.description: The published 42-item dataset behind a six-domain automation-discovery experiment, including score distribution, method, selection bias, and validation gates.

item.title: Safe Self-Improvement Automation: Detect, Repair, Verify, Roll Back
item.description: A production pattern for bounded self-improvement automation: declarative inventory, evidence-backed findings, risk-classed auto-fixes, preconditions, verification, rollback, reconciliation, and honest metrics.

item.title: Agent-to-Agent Negotiation by Email: A Pre-Experiment Protocol
item.description: An honest pre-experiment report for agent negotiation over email: what was built, what was not tested, the required metrics, safety controls, and a reproducible protocol.

item.title: How I Use an LLM to Prepare for a High-Stakes Negotiation
item.description: A privacy-conscious LLM negotiation-preparation protocol: define decision boundaries, rehearse difficult scenarios, challenge assumptions, and debrief without outsourcing judgment.

item.title: Designing a 90% Automated Product Pipeline—What Must Stay Human
item.description: An honest architecture case study of DreamForge: what agents can own from idea to pull request, where human approval remains essential, and how to validate automation safely.

item.title: Designing an On-Device Personal Memory System
item.description: EchoWeave is an unbuilt design proposal for private personal memory: an on-device architecture, consent and deletion model, threat analysis, resource constraints, and validation plan.

item.title: Agent Memory Architecture: Admission, Retrieval, Consolidation, and Forgetting
item.description: A production lifecycle for agent memory: memory classes, admission gates, provenance-aware retrieval, consolidation, contradiction handling, decay, deletion, evaluation, and cost accounting.

item.title: StartupGraph in Production: A Self-Hosted Startup Intelligence System
item.description: A production-minded case study of StartupGraph: 1,010 entities, field-level provenance, agent queries over MCP, and the limits of a self-hosted startup intelligence system.

item.title: AI Agent Execution Attestation: A Verifiable Audit Trail
item.description: A vendor-neutral execution-attestation design for AI agents: envelope schema, threat model, signing and verification flow, effect receipts, and a cryptographically verifiable example.

item.title: Compliance as Code for the EU AI Act: An Engineering Framework
item.description: A source-linked engineering framework for EU AI Act evidence: applicability, versioned controls, CI change impact, runtime records, approval gates, and audit packages.

item.title: Agent Reliability SLOs: Measure Correctness, Safety, and Recovery
item.description: A practical SLI/SLO framework for production AI agents: eligible journeys, verified task success, unsafe and duplicate effects, evidence completeness, recovery time, error budgets, and burn-rate alerts.

item.title: Build an Ideation Engine: A Repeatable Product Discovery System
item.description: A practical product ideation system with three analytical lenses, hard quality gates, deduplication, a weighted scorecard, rejected ideas, and a copyable validation workflow.

item.title: Build vs Buy Startup Intelligence: A Self-Hosted Entity Graph
item.description: A practical build-vs-buy framework grounded in a working DuckDB entity graph with field-level provenance, agent queries, and measured limitations.

item.title: The Security Risks of Unverified AI Agent Skills
item.description: A practical threat model for third-party agent skills: what manifests, checksums, approvals, signatures, sandboxes, and execution attestations can—and cannot—prove.

item.title: Stop Building Agent Soup: Use Compiler-Style Agent Workflows
item.description: A concrete compiler-style pattern for agent workflows: normalize intent into an intermediate representation, validate capabilities and policy, execute deterministically, and verify effects.

item.title: AI Agent Discovery Is a Bigger Bottleneck Than Reasoning
item.description: A five-stage capability-discovery model for AI agents: registry, semantic matching, compatibility, trust qualification, and policy-aware runtime selection.
